domains.name: Bulk RNA Sequencing and Differential Expression
domains.scope: Quantify transcript abundance and identify condition-, treatment-, time-, or genotype-associated expression changes in bulk RNA-sequencing experiments.

domains.name: Alternative Splicing and Isoform Analysis
domains.scope: Detect transcript isoforms, splice junctions, exon usage, intron retention, fusion transcripts, and condition-specific changes in RNA processing.

domains.name: Single-Cell Transcriptomics
domains.scope: Process cellular barcodes, remove technical artefacts, identify cell states, infer trajectories, and compare cell populations from single-cell RNA-sequencing data.

domains.name: Spatial Transcriptomics
domains.scope: Integrate spatially indexed transcript counts with tissue images to identify anatomical domains, cellular neighbourhoods, gradients, and localized expression programmes.

domains.name: Epigenomic Profiling
domains.scope: Analyse chromatin accessibility, protein-DNA occupancy, histone modifications, nucleosome organization, and DNA methylation using bulk epigenomic assays.

domains.name: Single-Cell and Spatial Epigenomics
domains.scope: Resolve chromatin accessibility, DNA methylation, histone state, and regulatory programmes across individual cells and spatially indexed tissue regions.

domains.name: Proteomics and Protein Quantification
domains.scope: Identify and quantify proteins from mass-spectrometry data using discovery, data-independent, targeted, label-free, or isobaric workflows.

domains.name: Post-Translational Modification Proteomics
domains.scope: Map and quantify phosphorylation, glycosylation, ubiquitination, acetylation, oxidation, and other protein modifications with localization-aware confidence control.

domains.name: Metabolomics and Lipidomics
domains.scope: Detect, annotate, quantify, and biologically interpret metabolites and lipid species while controlling analytical drift, blanks, identification confidence, and batch effects.

domains.name: Multi-Omics Integration and Systems Biology
domains.scope: Integrate heterogeneous molecular modalities into latent factors, networks, pathways, causal hypotheses, and interpretable multiscale models.

safety_boundary: Computational analysis, data validation, evidence synthesis, or reporting only; no autonomous wet-lab execution or unreviewed clinical decision.
